input: Draft a packing list for a backpacking trip

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: The destination and terrain (mountains, jungle, urban, coastal) drastically change what gear, clothing, and footwear are needed.
Trip duration determines quantities of clothing, food supplies, and whether resupply stops are needed.
Whether this is wilderness/backcountry camping or a hostel-hopping trip changes the entire category of items — tent vs. none, cooking gear vs. none, etc.
Solo vs. group travel affects shared gear (e.g., one tent, one stove), and travelling with children adds specific items.
A strict weight or bag-size limit (e.g., ultralight, carry-on only) forces hard trade-offs and changes every item choice.
The user's experience level (first-timer vs. seasoned backpacker) determines how much detail, explanation, or gear recommendation is needed.
Knowing whether the list should be a minimal essentials list or a comprehensive master checklist shapes length, format, and level of detail.

gold.taskTitle: Draft a backpacking trip packing list
gold.taskDescription: Create a personalised packing list for an upcoming backpacking trip.

questions.title: Where is the trip taking place?
questions.description: Identify the destination and terrain type — e.g., mountain wilderness, tropical jungle, coastal trail, or mixed urban/rural — to determine appropriate clothing, footwear, and environment-specific gear.

questions.title: How many days will the trip last?
questions.description: Pin down the total duration of the trip to calculate clothing quantities, food and water needs, and whether mid-trip resupply is an option.

questions.title: Will you be camping outdoors or staying in hostels?
questions.description: Determine whether the trip involves wild or campsite camping (requiring tent, sleeping bag, cooking gear) or accommodation-based travel (where much of that kit is unnecessary).

questions.title: Are you travelling solo or with others?
questions.description: Establish the group composition to identify opportunities to share heavy or bulky gear like tents, stoves, and first-aid kits, and to flag any items specific to children or group needs.

questions.title: Is there a target bag weight or size limit?
questions.description: Find out if the user is aiming for a specific pack weight (e.g., ultralight under 5 kg) or has a bag capacity constraint, which drives every trade-off decision on the list.

questions.title: How experienced are you with backpacking trips?
questions.description: Gauge the user's experience level to decide whether the list should include beginner-friendly explanations and gear recommendations or assume prior knowledge.

questions.title: Should this be a lean essentials list or a full master checklist?
questions.description: Clarify whether the user wants a stripped-back list of must-haves only, or a thorough checklist covering every possible category they can then edit down.
